key_insight: An uncertainty-conditioned framework turns genomic model predictions into traceable, graph-supported phenotype hypotheses whose breadth reflects upstream uncertainty.
clinical_relevance: This research could support uncertainty-aware interpretation of genomic evidence, but it does not establish patient-level diagnostic utility.
method: Score gene–disease–phenotype paths with an interpretable learned energy function.
Use calibrated prediction uncertainty to control probability-distribution temperature.
Aggregate path probabilities into phenotype hypotheses without patient-level phenotype supervision.
evidence_signal: On AlzKB and Hetionet, phenotype entropy tracked upstream uncertainty (Spearman 0.951 and 0.878); gene-holdout recall@10 exceeded DistMult on 24 of 30 graph masks (0.183 versus 0.123).
watch_item: The gene-holdout advantage was driven mainly by three genes with many variants and is not established across all genes.
paper_title: From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
